mapper.select: SELECT board_id AS id, board_name AS name, layout_json AS layout, category_id AS categoryId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM olap_board WHERE board_id = #{0}

SELECT board_id AS id, board_name AS NAME, layout_json AS layout, a.category_id AS categoryId, b.category_name AS categoryName, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM olap_board a LEFT JOIN olap_category b ON a.category_id = b.category_id ORDER BY a.board_name

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT board_id AS id, a.user_id AS userId, board_name AS NAME, layout_json AS layout, a.category_id AS categoryId, b.category_name AS categoryName, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM olap_board a LEFT JOIN olap_category b ON a.category_id = b.category_id ORDER BY a.board_name ) T WHERE T.ID IN (SELECT board_id FROM OLAP_USER_PERMISSION userPermission WHERE userPermission.USER_ID = #{currentUserId} ) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OLAP_ROLE_PERMISSION WHERE BOARD_ID = T.ID AND ROLE_ID IN (SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SYS_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = #{currentUserId} )) > 0 OR T.USERID = #{currentUserId} OR #{currentUserId} IN (SELECT ID FROM SYS_USER WHERE LOGIN_NAME='admin')
SELECT board_param_id id,board_id boardId,config FROM olap_board_param where board_id = #{0}
